title: Raids, and your name in lights
added: The raid sheet rebuilt: the boss, what it is weak to, and what you win, all in one place
Every card in a picker now shows its stats, with green for what this boss hates
Titles and name colours, earned and worn under your name wherever other players see it
Smudge gives advice when a raid goes badly
fixed: The pick you made is obvious now: a gold ring and a number
The close button no longer hides behind the artwork
Scrollbars match the rest of the game
Your three are called by name during a fight
The FC mark is off the cards; Founding Clerk is a title now
known: Alerts only reach you while the game is open

title: Alerts, pictures and a tidy-up
added: A bell up top for friend requests and gifts
Pick your profile picture from any hero you have met
Update notes, which you are reading
Update emails, if you tick the box in your account
fixed: Friend requests no longer turn up unannounced
The account picture is bigger and no longer squashed
Changes made on another device now show up when you come back
Card frames, the ink shop and the raid patch-up have proper names
known: Alerts only reach you while the game is open
A few heroes still talk without moving their mouths

title: Loot and gold
added: Buy ink with gold, a few pots a day
Pay gold to get resting heroes back on their feet
fixed: Era sets are three pieces everywhere
Gear for the newest heroes now drops
